entry.title: New: Resolution 209 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO HOʻOMALU KAʻŪ

Approves a grant of $28,000 to Hoʻomalu Kaʻū, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization for public safety maintenance and preservation of the Kahua ‘Olohū, Kaunāmano Property in Kaʻū, (Tax Map Key: 9-5-012:005), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.
